verses.text: Hear the word that the LORD speaks to you, O house of Israel.

xrefs.text: Listen and give heed. Do not be arrogant, for the LORD has spoken.

And we continually thank God because, when you received the word of God that you heard from us, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it truly is, the word of God, which is also now at work in you who believe.
Now, therefore, hear the word of the LORD. You say: ‘Do not prophesy against Israel; do not preach against the house of Isaac.’
then hear the word of the LORD, O remnant of Judah! This is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘If you are determined to go to Egypt and reside there,
Hear the word of the LORD, O children of Israel, for the LORD has a case against the people of the land: “There is no truth, no loving devotion, and no knowledge of God in the land!

verses.text: This is what the LORD says: “Do not learn the ways of the nations or be terrified by the signs in the heavens, though the nations themselves are terrified by them.

xrefs.text: You must not follow the statutes of the nations I am driving out before you. Because they did all these things, I abhorred them.

You must not follow the practices of the land of Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not follow the practices of the land of Canaan, into which I am bringing you. You must not walk in their customs.
There will be signs in the sun and moon and stars, and on the earth dismay among the nations, bewildered by the roaring of the sea and the surging of the waves.
When you say, ‘Let us be like the nations, like the peoples of the lands, serving wood and stone,’ what you have in mind will never come to pass.
be careful not to be ensnared by their ways after they have been destroyed before you. Do not inquire about their gods, asking, “How do these nations serve their gods? I will do likewise.”

verses.text: For the customs of the peoples are worthless; they cut down a tree from the forest; it is shaped with a chisel by the hands of a craftsman.

xrefs.text: All makers of idols are nothing, and the things they treasure are worthless. Their witnesses fail to see or comprehend, so they are put to shame.
For you know that it was not with perishable things such as silver or gold that you were redeemed from the empty way of life you inherited from your forefathers,
You must keep My charge not to practice any of the abominable customs that were practiced before you, so that you do not defile yourselves by them. I am the LORD your God.”
But they are altogether senseless and foolish, instructed by worthless idols made of wood!
For although they knew God, they neither glorified Him as God nor gave thanks to Him, but they became futile in their thinking and darkened in their foolish hearts.

verses.text: They adorn it with silver and gold and fasten it with hammer and nails, so that it will not totter.

xrefs.text: They lift it to their shoulder and carry it along; they set it in its place, and there it stands, not budging from that spot. They cry out to it, but it does not answer; it saves no one from his troubles.
To an idol that a craftsman casts and a metalworker overlays with gold and fits with silver chains?

The blacksmith takes a tool and labors over the coals; he fashions an idol with hammers and forges it with his strong arms. Yet he grows hungry and loses his strength; he fails to drink water and grows faint.
Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

verses.text: Like scarecrows in a cucumber patch, their idols cannot speak. They must be carried because they cannot walk. Do not fear them, for they can do no harm, and neither can they do any good.”

xrefs.text: They lift it to their shoulder and carry it along; they set it in its place, and there it stands, not budging from that spot. They cry out to it, but it does not answer; it saves no one from his troubles.
You know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.
Tell us the things that are to come, so that we may know that you are gods. Yes, do something good or evil, that we may look on together in dismay.
They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ or to silent stone, ‘Arise!’ Can it give guidance? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, yet there is no breath in it at all.”

verses.text: There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.

xrefs.text: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
Who among the gods is like You, O LORD? Who is like You— majestic in holiness, revered with praises, performing wonders?
A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.
“There is none like the God of Jeshurun, who rides the heavens to your aid, and the clouds in His majesty.
Cry out and sing, O citizen of Zion, for great among you is the Holy One of Israel.”

verses.text: Who would not fear You, O King of nations? This is Your due. For among all the wise men of the nations, and in all their kingdoms, there is none like You.

xrefs.text: Who will not fear You, O Lord, and glorify Your name? For You alone are holy. All nations will come and worship before You, for Your righteous acts have been revealed.
For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.

Do you not fear Me?” declares the LORD. “Do you not tremble before Me, the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea, an enduring barrier it cannot cross? The waves surge, but they cannot prevail. They roar but cannot cross it.
For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
There is none like You, O LORD. You are great, and Your name is mighty in power.

verses.text: But they are altogether senseless and foolish, instructed by worthless idols made of wood!

xrefs.text: For idols speak deceit and diviners see illusions; they tell false dreams and offer empty comfort. Therefore the people wander like sheep, oppressed for lack of a shepherd.
Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.
For although they knew God, they neither glorified Him as God nor gave thanks to Him, but they became futile in their thinking and darkened in their foolish hearts.
See, they are all a delusion; their works amount to nothing; their images are as empty as the wind.
Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.

verses.text: Hammered silver is brought from Tarshish, and gold from Uphaz— the work of a craftsman from the hands of a goldsmith. Their clothes are blue and purple, all fashioned by skilled workers.

xrefs.text: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
I lifted up my eyes, and behold, there was a certain man dressed in linen, with a belt of fine gold from Uphaz around his waist.
For the king had the ships of Tarshish at sea with Hiram’s fleet, and once every three years the ships of Tarshish would arrive bearing gold, silver, ivory, apes, and peacocks.
To an idol that a craftsman casts and a metalworker overlays with gold and fits with silver chains?
Tarshish was your merchant because of your great wealth of goods; they exchanged silver, iron, tin, and lead for your wares.

verses.text: But the LORD is the true God; He is the living God and eternal King. The earth quakes at His wrath, and the nations cannot endure His indignation.

xrefs.text: He is the Rock, His work is perfect; all His ways are just. A God of faithfulness without injustice, righteous and upright is He.

For thus says the One who is high and lifted up, who inhabits eternity, whose name is Holy: “I dwell in a high and holy place, and with the oppressed and humble in spirit, to restore the spirit of the lowly and revive the heart of the contrite.
Who can withstand His indignation? Who can endure His burning anger? His wrath is poured out like fire; even rocks are shattered before Him.
You alone are to be feared. When You are angry, who can stand before You?
He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.

verses.text: Thus you are to tell them: “These gods, who have made neither the heavens nor the earth, will perish from this earth and from under these heavens.”

xrefs.text: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
and the idols will vanish completely.
They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.
They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.
You will pursue them in anger and exterminate them from under Your heavens, O LORD.

verses.text: The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.

xrefs.text: He alone stretches out the heavens and treads on the waves of the sea.
In the beginning God created the heavens and the earth.
The LORD founded the earth by wisdom and established the heavens by understanding.
He sits enthroned above the circle of the earth; its dwellers are like grasshoppers. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain, and spreads them out like a tent to dwell in.
For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.

verses.text: When He thunders, the waters in the heavens roar; He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.

xrefs.text: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
Have you entered the storehouses of snow or observed the storehouses of hail,
The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded— hailstones and coals of fire.
Can you command the clouds so that a flood of water covers you?
Listen closely to the thunder of His voice and the rumbling that comes from His mouth.

verses.text: Every man is senseless and devoid of knowledge; every goldsmith is put to shame by his idols. For his molten images are a fraud, and there is no breath in them.

xrefs.text: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.

They lift it to their shoulder and carry it along; they set it in its place, and there it stands, not budging from that spot. They cry out to it, but it does not answer; it saves no one from his troubles.
What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it— or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
They do not comprehend or discern, for He has shut their eyes so they cannot see and closed their minds so they cannot understand.

verses.text: They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.

xrefs.text: Can the worthless idols of the nations bring rain? Do the skies alone send showers? Is this not by You, O LORD our God? So we put our hope in You, for You have done all these things.
Behold, you are nothing and your work is of no value. Anyone who chooses you is detestable.
They are worthless, a work to be mocked. In the time of their punishment they will perish.

Are they ashamed of the abomination they have committed? No, they have no shame at all; they do not even know how to blush. So they will fall among the fallen; when I punish them, they will collapse, says the LORD.

And on that day, declares the LORD of Hosts, I will erase the names of the idols from the land, and they will no longer be remembered. I will also remove the prophets and the spirit of impurity from the land.

verses.text: The Portion of Jacob is not like these, for He is the Maker of all things, and Israel is the tribe of His inheritance— the LORD of Hosts is His name.

xrefs.text: But the LORD’s portion is His people, Jacob His allotted inheritance.
Thus says the LORD, who gives the sun for light by day, who sets in order the moon and stars for light by night, who stirs up the sea so that its waves roar— the LORD of Hosts is His name:
You show loving devotion to thousands but lay the iniquity of the fathers into the laps of their children after them, O great and mighty God whose name is the LORD of Hosts,
The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
The LORD made the earth by His power; He established the world by His wisdom and stretched out the heavens by His understanding.

verses.text: Gather up your belongings from this land, you who live under siege.

xrefs.text: Therefore, son of man, pack your bags for exile. In broad daylight, set out from your place and go to another as they watch. Perhaps they will understand, though they are a rebellious house.
[“]Run for cover, O sons of Benjamin; flee from Jerusalem! Sound the ram’s horn in Tekoa; send up a signal over Beth-haccherem, for disaster looms from the north, even great destruction.
So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination of desolation,’ spoken of by the prophet Daniel (let the reader understand),
Arise and depart, for this is not your place of rest, because its defilement brings destruction— a grievous destruction!
Behold, I am against you who dwell above the valley, atop the rocky plateau— declares the LORD— you who say, “Who can come against us? Who can enter our dwellings?”

verses.text: For this is what the LORD says: “Behold, at this time I will sling out the inhabitants of the land and bring distress upon them so that they may be captured.”

xrefs.text: And should someone pursue you and seek your life, then the life of my lord will be bound securely by the LORD your God in the bundle of the living. But He shall fling away the lives of your enemies like stones from a sling.

But did not My words and My statutes, which I commanded My servants the prophets, overtake your fathers? They repented and said, ‘Just as the LORD of Hosts purposed to do to us according to our ways and deeds, so He has done to us.’”
Then the LORD said to me: “Even if Moses and Samuel should stand before Me, My heart would not go out to this people. Send them from My presence, and let them go!
And they will know that I am the LORD; I did not declare in vain that I would bring this calamity upon them.
The anger of the LORD will not turn back until He has fully accomplished the purposes of His heart. In the days to come you will understand this clearly.

verses.text: Woe to me because of my brokenness; my wound is grievous! But I said, “This is truly my sickness, and I must bear it.”

xrefs.text: Because I have sinned against Him, I must endure the rage of the LORD, until He argues my case and executes justice for me. He will bring me into the light; I will see His righteousness.

You are to speak this word to them: ‘My eyes overflow with tears; day and night they do not cease, for the virgin daughter of my people has been shattered by a crushing blow, a severely grievous wound.
Why should any mortal man complain, in view of his sins?
So I say, “My strength has perished, along with my hope from the LORD.”

For I hear a cry like a woman in labor, a cry of anguish like one bearing her first child— the cry of the Daughter of Zion gasping for breath, stretching out her hands to say, “Woe is me, for my soul faints before the murderers!”

verses.text: My tent is destroyed, and all its ropes are snapped. My sons have departed from me and are no more. I have no one left to pitch my tent or set up my curtains.

xrefs.text: Disaster after disaster is proclaimed, for the whole land is laid waste. My tents are destroyed in an instant, my curtains in a moment.
This is what the LORD says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, mourning and great weeping, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”
Yet the children of your bereavement will say in your hearing, ‘This place is too small for us; make room for us to live here.’
“Enlarge the site of your tent, stretch out the curtains of your dwellings, do not hold back. Lengthen your ropes and drive your stakes in deep.
I have put My words in your mouth, and covered you with the shadow of My hand, to establish the heavens, to found the earth, and to say to Zion, ‘You are My people.’”

verses.text: For the shepherds have become senseless; they do not seek the LORD. Therefore they have not prospered, and all their flock is scattered.

xrefs.text: Many shepherds have destroyed My vineyard; they have trampled My plot of ground. They have turned My pleasant field into a desolate wasteland.

“Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel. Prophesy and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Woe to the shepherds of Israel, who only feed themselves! Should not the shepherds feed their flock?
“Woe to the shepherds who destroy and scatter the sheep of My pasture!” declares the LORD.
Israel’s watchmen are blind, they are all oblivious; they are all mute dogs, they cannot bark; they are dreamers lying around, loving to slumber.
“My anger burns against the shepherds, and I will punish the leaders. For the LORD of Hosts attends to His flock, the house of Judah; He will make them like His royal steed in battle.

verses.text: Listen! The sound of a report is coming— a great commotion from the land to the north. It will make the cities of Judah a desolation, a haunt for jackals.

xrefs.text: “And I will make Jerusalem a heap of rubble, a haunt for jackals; and I will make the cities of Judah a desolation, without inhabitant.”

Behold, I am bringing a distant nation against you, O house of Israel,” declares the LORD. “It is an established nation, an ancient nation, a nation whose language you do not know and whose speech you do not understand.
Raise a signal flag toward Zion. Seek refuge! Do not delay! For I am bringing disaster from the north, and terrible destruction.
[“]Run for cover, O sons of Benjamin; flee from Jerusalem! Sound the ram’s horn in Tekoa; send up a signal over Beth-haccherem, for disaster looms from the north, even great destruction.
For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans that ruthless and impetuous nation which marches through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.

verses.text: I know, O LORD, that a man’s way is not his own; no one who walks directs his own steps.

xrefs.text: A man’s steps are from the LORD, so how can anyone understand his own way?
The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
The plans of the heart belong to man, but the reply of the tongue is from the LORD.
Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
My steps have held to Your paths; my feet have not slipped.

verses.text: Correct me, O LORD, but only with justice — not in Your anger, or You will bring me to nothing.

xrefs.text: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.

For I am with you to save you, declares the LORD. Though I will completely destroy all the nations to which I have scattered you, I will not completely destroy you. Yet I will discipline you justly, and will by no means leave you unpunished.”
Caravans turn aside from their routes; they go into the wasteland and perish.
He brings the princes to nothing and makes the rulers of the earth meaningless.

verses.text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, and on the families that do not call on Your name. For they have devoured Jacob; they have consumed him and finished him off; they have devastated his homeland.

xrefs.text: Pour out Your wrath on the nations that do not acknowledge You, on the kingdoms that refuse to call on Your name,

The snorting of enemy horses is heard from Dan. At the sound of the neighing of mighty steeds, the whole land quakes. They come to devour the land and everything in it, the city and all who dwell in it.
Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon the LORD.
Surely such is the dwelling of the wicked and the place of one who does not know God.”
in blazing fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus.
